name: network
title: Network
about: Shows where: one node per cluster, coloured by how many of its features pass the filters, with edges between clusters whose courses predict each other.

method.how: for each cluster, a random forest predicts its centre (mean course over the timepoints) from the centres of all other clusters; the weight of an edge is the importance of the predictor (% increase in mean squared error when it is permuted), and the strongest predictors of each cluster are kept (ntop in gNetwork(), 10 by default)
method.note: the page draws an edge between two clusters once (the larger of the two directions) when its weight is above the importance score; an edge means the two courses are related, not that the curves look alike, and not that one cluster causes the other; the weight is a ranking, not a test (see method.md in this folder)

shows.node colour: number of features of the cluster that pass both filters, grey (0) to green (most); every feature when both filters are on All
shows.edge: a pair of clusters with weight above the importance score
shows.edge opacity: weight, rescaled over the edges drawn
shows.outline: selected clusters; the others are faded when only some are selected

reads.level1: recolours the nodes by the count of passing features; nodes and edges stay
reads.level2: recolours the nodes by the count of passing features; nodes and edges stay
reads.minWeight: redraws the edges with weight above it
reads.layout: moves the nodes (force, circle, grid) and clears the brush
reads.selectedClusters: outlines the selected nodes and fades the others

writes.selectedClusters: brushing a rectangle, clicking a node, clicking the empty canvas (all), the buttons Select all and Clear all

features.name: edges
features.how: number of edges of a cluster at the importance score in use

features.name: neighbours
features.how: the clusters that share an edge with a cluster at the importance score in use

features.name: strongest_edge
features.how: the pair of clusters with the highest weight

features.name: components
features.how: sets of clusters joined by edges at the importance score in use

knowledge.writer: How the agent should word it

target.network: edges, connected, isolated, strongest edge, neighbours

descriptor.weight: see the network card when loaded.
